messages.text:
The refund proposal is for **BRL 150.00** for the cordless screwdriver. It can only go to the original payment method, not a new card; a cancelled card doesn’t change that, and the card issuer handles any credit (refund-policy/v2/payment).

If you accept the proposal, confirm it using the button on the proposal card. A message in chat won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member reviews it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
The customer confirmed request prop-6bf1ef1f3265454b and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The **BRL 150.00** refund has been recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt: **R-00000001**. This is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for when the credit may appear on your card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
Glad to hear it. The refund was recorded under receipt **R-00000001**.
